description: Every metric a RunnerQ SDK emits, so Go and TypeScript dashboards read the same names. Counters count events since the worker started; histograms are in their unit (seconds for durations); gauges are sampled. A metric carries exactly the labels listed for it, with the label values described under labels. Exporters that share a namespace with other software prefix the names with "runnerq." (an OpenTelemetry instrument runnerq.activity_started, a Prometheus series runnerq_activity_started_total).

labels.name: status
labels.doc: A canonical activity status (vectors/canonical_status.json): pending, scheduled, running, waiting or dead_letter.

metrics.name: activity_started
metrics.doc: Attempts claimed whose handler started on this worker.

metrics.name: activity_completed
metrics.doc: Activities that completed successfully on this worker.

metrics.name: activity_completion_error
metrics.doc: Completions that could not be recorded for a reason other than a lost claim: a permanent storage error, or shutdown ended the retries.

metrics.name: activity_completion_pending_started
metrics.doc: Completions whose recording started. Started minus finished is how many are being recorded.

metrics.name: activity_completion_pending_finished
metrics.doc: Completions whose recording finished, successfully or not.

metrics.name: activity_retry
metrics.doc: Attempts that failed with a retryable error (a timeout counts as activity_timeout instead).

metrics.name: activity_failed_non_retry
metrics.doc: Activities that failed permanently with a non-retryable error.

metrics.name: activity_timeout
metrics.doc: Attempts that exceeded the activity's timeout.

metrics.name: activity_dead_lettered
metrics.doc: Activities that ran out of attempts and were dead-lettered.

metrics.name: activity_dead_letter_hook_panic
metrics.doc: Dead-letter hooks that threw or panicked (the failure is recovered and logged). Only SDKs with a dead-letter hook emit it.

metrics.name: activity_claim_lost
metrics.doc: Attempts that lost their claim: revoked mid-handler, or the outcome was fenced off because another execution owns the activity.

metrics.name: activity_heartbeat_failed
metrics.doc: Claim renewals that failed and will be retried on the next beat.

metrics.name: activity_yielded
metrics.doc: Attempts that parked the activity for a durable wait (sleep, signal or awaited result).

metrics.name: activity_trees_swept
metrics.doc: Terminal workflow trees deleted by retention.

metrics.name: schedule_fires
metrics.doc: Activities enqueued by firing due schedules.

metrics.name: storage_retry
metrics.doc: Storage writes made for an attempt (completion, failure, park, checkpoint, spawn) that failed transiently and are being retried.

metrics.name: activity_claim_lag
metrics.doc: How long an activity waited from when it was due until a worker started it.

metrics.name: activity_execution
metrics.doc: How long an attempt took on this worker, from its start until its outcome was recorded.

metrics.name: activity_completion_persistence
metrics.doc: How long recording a completion took, retries included.

metrics.name: queue_depth
metrics.doc: Activities in the queue by status, for the statuses listed under the status label. Sampled from the storage's aggregate query; a combination that has dropped to zero is reported as 0.

metrics.name: queue_oldest_pending_age
metrics.doc: How long the oldest pending (due, unclaimed) activity has been due; 0 when none is pending. Sampled with queue_depth.

metrics.name: activities_in_flight
metrics.doc: Attempts running on this worker now, for every activity type it serves.
